name: Ghost Game V2
summary:
Become a playful ghost in Ghost Game V2, a fun and energetic social VR experience designed for Meta Quest. Move just like in Gorilla Tag—using your hands to walk, run, and climb through unique maps.

Hang out with other players, make new friends, and customize your ghost with a growing collection of cosmetics. New maps and items are added regularly, so there’s always something fresh to explore.

It’s all about fun and friendly vibes—but don’t forget the rules. Break them, and the vent ghosts might come out
